How It Works

Four steps. Machine on site.

From a 2-day job to a full project contract — 2 days, 5 days, a week, or the whole build. Short hires are welcome here.

1

Tell us what you need

WhatsApp or the form below — the machine, the site, the dates. Two days or two years, both work.

2

We match the machine

We review the fleet and pick the right machine for the job — checked, fueled and ready.

3

Quote & schedule

Clear price, clear timing. Day, week or full contract terms — no surprises later.

4

Delivered, operator included

We deliver to your site anywhere in Kuwait, our operator in the cab, support on call 24/7.

About Al Manar

Al Manar Al Asriya — General Trading & Contracting Co. supplies Kuwait's projects with heavy machinery that shows up ready, with the people to run it. Our vision is simple: be the first name builders think of when a project needs a machine — and earn it with a fleet that's always ready and a promise that's always kept, backed by our own workshops, storage yards and a safety-first crew.

Excellence

Machines maintained to a standard, operators who take pride in the work.

Innovation

Modern fleet and planning — AutoCAD, BIM, better ways of working.

Integrity

Clear terms, honest timelines, a contract we stand behind.

Sustainability

Well-kept machines burn less, last longer, keep sites cleaner.
